Name: Bath (cold)
Description: Basic cold water bath at a public bathhouse or inn. Unheated water, minimal amenities. Gets you clean but not comfortable.

Name: Bath (hot)
Description: Hot water bath with heated water. Much more comfortable than cold. Popular after long adventures. Water must be heated, hence the higher cost.

Name: Bath (public)
Description: Access to public bathhouse facilities with heated pools, steam rooms, and social bathing areas. Price varies by quality of establishment from basic communal baths to luxury spa experiences.

Name: Commissioned Broadsheet (print run - 500 broadsheets)
Description: Print 500 copies of your broadsheet after setup is complete. Includes paper, ink, press time, and labor for a full print run. Used for spreading news, announcements, or propaganda.

Name: Commissioned Broadsheet (setup and proof print)
Description: Initial setup for printing including typesetting, layout, and proof print to verify accuracy before full print run. Essential first step before mass printing.

Name: Companion
Description: Hired companion for social events or private entertainment. Price varies wildly based on quality, services provided, and social standing. From simple escort to elite courtesan.

Name: Doctor
Description: Medical consultation and treatment from a trained physician. Covers examination, diagnosis, and basic medical care. Does not include expensive medicines or surgery.

Name: Footman
Description: Servant who runs errands, carries packages, opens doors, and performs basic household tasks. Per day rate for a personal attendant.

Name: Hireling (trained)
Description: Skilled worker with specific trade or professional training. Includes craftsmen, scribes, sailors, and other trained laborers. Daily wage for competent help.

Name: Hireling (untrained)
Description: Unskilled laborer for manual work like digging, carrying, loading wagons, or general tasks. Cheapest labor available. Daily wage for basic muscle.

Name: Hireling, Crier (masterful)
Description: Elite town crier with booming voice, perfect diction, and commanding presence. Makes your message heard and remembered across entire districts. Most expensive crier option.

Name: Hireling, Crier (skilled)
Description: Experienced town crier with strong voice and good delivery. Effectively announces messages to crowds and spreads word throughout neighborhoods.

Name: Hireling, Crier (trained)
Description: Competent town crier who can clearly announce messages in public spaces. Standard option for spreading news or announcements.

Name: Hireling, Crier (untrained)
Description: Basic messenger who shouts your message in streets. Lacks polish but gets the job done cheaply. Sufficient for simple announcements.

Name: Inn Stay (common)
Description: Standard inn room with bed, basic furnishings, and simple breakfast. Clean sheets, shared common areas. The adventurer's default lodging choice.

Name: Inn Stay (good)
Description: Quality inn with comfortable bed, better meals, private room, and nice amenities. Popular with successful adventurers and merchants.

Name: Inn Stay (poor)
Description: Cheap flophouse with straw mattress, thin blanket, and questionable cleanliness. Often shared room with strangers. You get what you pay for.

Name: Inn Stay (suite, average)
Description: Multiple-room suite with bedroom, sitting area, and better furnishings. Suitable for small parties or those desiring privacy and comfort.

Name: Inn Stay (suite, luxurious)
Description: Opulent multi-room suite with finest furnishings, servants, private bath, excellent meals, and luxury amenities. For nobility and the very wealthy. 32+ gp depending on establishment.

Name: Inn Stay (suite, small)
Description: Two-room suite with separate sleeping and living areas. More spacious than single room, affordable luxury for adventuring parties.

Name: Laundry
Description: Washing, drying, and basic folding of clothes. Standard service for keeping adventuring gear clean after dungeon delving.

Name: Laundry (magic)
Description: Magical cleaning using prestidigitation or similar spells. Instant, perfect cleaning that removes all stains, odors, and damage to fabric. Worth it after fighting in sewers!

Name: Lawyer (competent)
Description: Experienced lawyer capable of handling most legal matters competently. Standard choice for civil cases, contracts, and legal representation.

Name: Lawyer (experienced)
Description: Highly skilled lawyer with extensive experience and excellent success rate. For serious criminal cases, complex contracts, or when you absolutely need to win.

Name: Lawyer (novice)
Description: Newly practicing lawyer with basic training. Suitable for simple matters or when funds are limited. You get what you pay for.

Name: Messenger
Description: Runner who delivers messages, packages, or letters. Paid by distance traveled. Faster than mail, more discreet than town crier. 2 copper per mile.

Name: Nurse
Description: Medical caretaker who provides bedside care, administers medicines, changes bandages, and monitors patient condition. Essential for recovering from serious wounds.

Name: Road or Gate Toll
Description: Fee for using maintained roads or entering city gates. Standard infrastructure tax. Some locations charge more for carts or livestock.

Name: Scribe (map)
Description: Professional cartographer creates accurate map from your descriptions or copies existing maps. Includes artistic borders and clear labels. Essential for dungeon mapping.

Name: Scribe (text)
Description: Professional scribe copies text, writes letters, or transcribes documents. Includes high-quality penmanship and accurate transcription. Per page or letter.

Name: Spellcasting
Description: Hiring a spellcaster to cast a spell. Formula: caster level × spell level × 10 gp. Examples: 1st level spell from 1st level caster = 10 gp; 3rd level spell from 5th level caster = 150 gp; 9th level spell from 17th level caster = 1,530 gp. Does not include costly material components - those are extra.

Name: Valet
Description: Personal servant who maintains clothing, prepares outfits, assists with dressing, and handles personal effects. Daily rate for proper gentleman's/lady's attendant.
